title: 010 双线？

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    无言走在街道上，手上却拿着一份清单，上面写满着巨兽森林各种魔兽的身体材料与稀有天材地宝的价值估量。
行走江湖，怎么能缺少盘缠呢？升级固然重要，但是打钱也是重中之重啊…
但是无言初来咋到，也不知道这里的市场怎么样，要是本来一金币的东西被坑成十金币，那不就亏大发了？所以无言就跟菲菲要来了这么一份清单。
无言一边毫无目的的走着，一边翻着手中的清单，这份清单上面，不只是有魔兽的身体材料和天材地宝的价值，连装备的价值清单上面都有。
不过在这里，人们把装备称为兵装，除了一般战士使用的普通兵器之外，对实力有点加成的装备都叫做兵装。
根据兵装的效果和威力的不同，兵装也分为五个层次，分别是大众兵装、稀有兵装、黄金兵装、传奇兵装还有最强的神话兵装！
而自己那D级的草薙剑，就是相当于一件大众兵装！
可不要以为有个‘大众’二字，大众兵装就是便宜货，所谓的大众，并不是说这个世界上的人人手一件，才叫大众兵装的。
大众的意思是，大部分的战士和魔法师，都只能使用这个层次的兵装，所以才叫做大众兵装。
一般的战士和魔法师，若是条件好的，便会有一件大众兵装，若是条件不好的，可能只有到五阶甚至六阶的时候，才会佩的起一件大众兵装，只有七阶以上的战士或者魔法师，才有可能拥有一件稀有兵装，像菲菲，她就是拥有着一件稀有兵装！
当然，像露露这样的大家族独生女，就算只有四阶，她也有一件稀有兵装，这还是她16岁生日的时候她父亲送给她的生日礼物，在此之前，露露也是一直用的大众兵装。
而黄金兵装，一般七阶的人是没有可能拥有的，当然，个别有其它际遇的人除外，黄金兵装，一般都是八阶甚至九阶的强者，才会拥有一件黄金兵装，像露露的爷爷，洛莉家的上一代族长，九阶的强者，就是用的黄金兵装。
至于传奇兵装，在整个斯巴利尔世界，只有流传下来的区区不到十件而已，还不知道去向。
最后，菲菲给无言这份清单的时候，告诉无言，那最强的神话兵装，她是听都没听过，更别说见过了，只有小的时候，听到露露的爷爷提起过，好像在万年前，四位神灵还在的时候，有过那么一件神话兵装。
无言还记得自己刚刚听到的时候，还暗暗咋舌，这个在系统评价有十个地球那么大的斯巴利尔世界，从古至今，居然只有一件神话兵装！
按照系统结合无言手中的清单之后的说法是，斯巴利尔世界的五个兵装级别，与系统的装备级别，是一致的！
系统的装备也分为五个层次，最低的D级，到最高的S级，当然，那些没有级别的装备，勉强算是一个级别的吧。
无言的草薙剑是D级，对应大众兵装，所以，系统里，那些C级的装备对应的就是稀有兵装了，B级对应黄金兵装，A级对应传奇兵装，S级对应神话兵装。
当听到系统的解析之后，无言心中就即是欢喜，又是懊恼。
欢喜的是，人人传为传说的神话兵装，也就是S级的装备，在系统里，有！

不但有，而且比起只有一件神话兵装的斯巴利尔世界，系统里的S级装备可就不只一件了，虽然也不多，但怎么也比这个世界要好的多了。
而懊恼的就是，无言只能现在看着开心而已，因为无言看过了，最便宜的一件S级装备，价格是100万装备点！
满打满算，无言现在的装备点，也才24000点，要等到他换得起S级装备，大概有得等了…
懊恼过后，无言也就看开了，毕竟，他也不过刚刚20级而已，换算为这个世界的层次，就是刚刚才突破三阶，三阶就拥有一件大众兵装，已经算是很不错的了，要不然，当初无言也不会靠着草薙剑和‘剑道精通’杀了那条死狼了。
就连那只史莱姆，都只能抓一把中看不中用的骑士剑，连一件大众兵装都没有，他还是人家艾路帝国第一家族的一只骑兵队队长呢，虽然才三阶，但是连他都没有一把大众兵装，可以想象，这个世界的兵装，有多么珍贵了。
原本还打算换取一把C级的稀有兵装的，不过现在无言放弃了，稀有兵装，一般都只有七阶的强者才能拥有，如果自己区区一个三阶的战士拥有一把稀有兵装，我想，那些还在苦恼没有稀有兵装的七阶强者，肯定不会介意窜一次抢劫犯…

Wuyan was walking on the street, but he was holding a list in his hand, which was filled with estimated values ​​of the body materials of various monsters in the monster forest and the rare heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
How can one travel around the world without money? Upgrading is important, but making money is also a top priority...
But Wu Yan first came here, and he didn’t know what the market was like here. If something that originally cost one gold coin was cheated into ten gold coins, wouldn’t it be a huge loss? So Wuyan asked Feifei for such a list.
Wu Yan walked aimlessly while flipping through the list in his hand. On this list, there was not only the value of the body materials of the Warcraft and the treasures of heaven and earth, but also the value of the equipment.
However, here, people refer to equipment as military equipment. In addition to the ordinary weapons used by ordinary soldiers, equipment that adds some bonus to strength is called military equipment.
According to the effect and power of the weapons, the weapons are also divided into five levels, namely popular weapons, rare weapons, gold weapons, legendary weapons and the strongest mythical weapons!
And his D-level Kusanagi sword is equivalent to a mass weapon!
But don't think that there is a word "mass". Mass military uniforms are cheap goods. The so-called mass does not mean that everyone in the world has one. It is called mass military uniforms.
Popular means that most warriors and magicians can only use this level of weapons, so it is called popular weapons.
Ordinary warriors and magicians, if the conditions are good, will have a common weapon. If the conditions are not good, they may not be able to wear a common weapon until they reach the fifth or even sixth level. Only warriors or magicians of the seventh level or above may have a rare weapon. Like Feifei, she has a rare weapon!
Of course, the only daughter of a big family like Lulu, even if she is only at the fourth level, she still has a rare weapon. This was a birthday gift from her father on her 16th birthday. Before that, Lulu had always used popular weapons.
As for golden weapons, it is generally impossible for seventh-level people to own them. Of course, except for a few people who have other circumstances, golden weapons are usually only owned by strong men of the eighth or even ninth level. For example, Lulu's grandfather, the previous generation patriarch of the Loli family, and the ninth-level warriors, used golden weapons.
As for the legendary weapons, there are only less than ten pieces that have been handed down in the entire Sparir world, and their whereabouts are still unknown.
Finally, when Feifei gave Wu Yan the list, she told him that she had never heard of the most powerful mythical weapon, let alone seen it. When she was young, she heard Lulu's grandfather mention it. It seemed that there was such a mythical weapon ten thousand years ago when the four gods were still around.
Wuyan still remembers that he was secretly stunned when he heard it. This world of Sparil, which is as big as ten earths according to the system evaluation, has only one mythical weapon from ancient times to the present!
According to what the system combined with the list in Wu Yan's hand, the five military equipment levels in Sparil's world are consistent with the system's equipment levels!
The system's equipment is also divided into five levels, from the lowest level D to the highest level S. Of course, those equipment without levels can barely be regarded as one level.
The silent Kusanagi Sword is D-level, corresponding to popular weapons. Therefore, in the system, those C-level equipment correspond to rare weapons, B-level corresponds to golden weapons, A-level corresponds to legendary weapons, and S-level corresponds to mythical weapons.
After hearing the system's analysis, Wu Yan felt both happy and annoyed at the same time.
Happily, the mythical weapons that everyone has passed down as legends, that is, S-level equipment, are available in the system!
Not only that, but compared to Spariel who only has one mythical weaponIn this world, there is more than one S-level equipment in the system. Although it is not much, it is still much better than this world.
What is annoying is that Wu Yan can only look at it happily now, because Wu Yan has seen that the cheapest piece of S-level equipment costs 1 million equipment points!
After all the calculations, Wuyan's current equipment points are only 24,000. He will probably have to wait until he can afford S-level equipment...
After feeling annoyed, Wu Yan looked away. After all, he was only at level 20. Calculated in this world, he had just broken through level three. Having a mass weapon at level three was already considered very good. Otherwise, Wu Yan wouldn't have killed that dead wolf with the Kusanagi Sword and 'Mastery of Swordsmanship'.
Even that slime could only grab a useless knight's sword, and he didn't even have a common weapon. He was the captain of a cavalry team of the first family of the Elu Empire. Although he was only at the third level, he didn't even have a common weapon. You can imagine how precious the weapons in this world are.
I originally planned to exchange for a C-level rare weapon, but now I have given up. Rare weapons are generally only owned by seventh-level warriors. If a mere third-level warrior owns a rare weapon, I think those seventh-level warriors who are still worried about not having rare weapons will definitely not mind a robber...
